meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按六个步骤带你走完:检查 AKS 集群、安装 controller、评估 GPU、选装推理 provider、部署第一个模型、最后总结。每步报告集群状态(健康或缺失),并在安装或部署前先征求你确认。
howto.when: 当你提到「setup AI Runway」「install AI Runway」「deploy model to AKS」等说法,或想在已有的 AKS 集群上装 controller、跑 GPU 推理时触发。集群不存在时会先转到 azure-kubernetes 技能建集群。

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through six steps: cluster check, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, first model deployment, then a summary. It reports cluster state at each step and asks for confirmation before installs or deployments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "setup AI Runway", "install AI Runway" or "deploy model to AKS", or want to install the controller and run GPU inference on an existing AKS cluster. Without a cluster it hands off to azure-kubernetes first.
